observations.title: Build walls along a diagonal
observations.player_action: Place compatible walls diagonally adjacent to one another.
observations.outcome: The wall geometry connects diagonally for less rigid outlines.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Inspect actual wall connection states for a placement criterion; a player's possession of a wall does not prove a diagonal build.

observations.title: Account for wall stacking appearance
observations.player_action: Inspect vertically stacked walls when planning a build.
observations.outcome: The author warns that the diagonal implementation removes upward wall connections and leaves visible gaps when walls stack.
conditions: The upstream describes this as a technical tradeoff, not a local JEM defect.
